name: Midwest Gaming Classic
blurb: A 350,000+ sq ft Milwaukee gaming trade show with free-play arcade, pinball and console games, plus tabletop, RPGs and industry guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage (read via a Wayback Machine snapshot; see notes): 'Thank you for joining us at the 2026 Midwest Gaming Classic! SAVE THE DATE! APRIL 23-25, 2027! Baird Center 400 W. Wisconsin Avenue Milwaukee, WI 53203'

notes: The live site returns a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' bot-check (HTTP 403) to extract.mjs (including --channel msedge --fresh) and to WebFetch, so it was read via a Wayback Machine snapshot captured 2026-05-08 instead (saved as midwest-gaming-classic.home.json) - WebSearch independently confirmed the same Apr 23-25, 2027 / Baird Center dates from the site's own page title and a local-news tweet. The /meet/ guests page's nearest Wayback snapshot (2026-03-26) was itself a Cloudflare challenge page with no content, so no 2027 guest lineup could be read; marked 'none-yet' since the show is ~6 months out and no announcement was found elsewhere. Short name 'MGC' taken from the site's own asset naming (mgc-logo-vector.svg, mgc-order.php). Cover uses the site's vector logo (no genuine wide key-art banner was found; the homepage's other images are small square nav-card thumbnails). Organizer entity not found.
